## About
Chris' A/C & Full Auto Service is a car repair shop on N Burleson Blvd in Burleson, run by owner operator Chris Tucker. Our mission is to get your car fixed and back on the road as fast as possible.
Whether you need a routine inspection or a repair, we use parts from reputable brands so your vehicle is ready to drive. One longtime customer wrote that Chris is always happy to explain everything that goes into a repair, so you understand and feel at ease.
Burleson drivers have given us a 4.4 rating across 208 Google reviews. Stop by during business hours or give us a call.

## Services
- A/C compressor: When your A/C goes out, Chris can diagnose it and put in a new compressor if that's what it needs.
- Serpentine belt: A snapped serpentine belt can leave you stuck. Chris gets it fixed so you can get moving again.
- Coolant thermostat: Chris replaced one customer's coolant thermostat in 30 minutes.

## FAQ
Q: Do your services come with warranties?
A: Yes. We provide 3-month labor warranties with all of our services, and parts can be lifetime.

Q: Do I need an appointment?
A: One reviewer walked in without an appointment and was taken right away.

Q: What forms of payment do you take?
A: A recent reviewer noted the shop takes cash or check only, so plan ahead and bring cash or a checkbook.

I contacted Chris and told him about the issue. He said “if you bring me the part from Kia, I can install it for you in under an hour.”

I bought the part from Kia, brought my car to Kia and Chris replaced the coolant thermostat in 30 minutes.

Instead of paying $800 at the dealership, he charged me $150 total for his time. I spent less than $200 total, so Chris saved me $600.  He has gained a new loyal customer.

Very happy with his customer service and flexibility, he was able to get me in immediately." (Rebecca Wood, 5/5)
